categories.additive: An optional field, enum value, diagnostic, or report detail that old readers can ignore without changing existing meaning.
categories.breaking: A required field, removed field, changed identity, changed meaning, or incompatible output shape that requires a new major contract version.
categories.deprecated: A still-readable field or value retained for one documented compatibility window and excluded from new output.
categories.migration-required: A change that can be made deterministic only by rewriting an artifact or requiring an explicit reader migration before use.
